statement: For every U<=L, the actual refined-level and coarse-level direct sums of H1(U intersect X_xi;D_U) inject into H1(U;D_U); the corresponding one-slot assertions hold inside every refined and coarse vertex row, already over the original induced modules.
coefficient_order: coefficients on the left; group-ring entries multiply on the right
coefficient_generalization: Any right group-ring module faithfully embedded in an ambient division ring; no inverses or flatness in the module are required.
coverage: all subgroups, including infinitely generated and trivial subgroups
every actual double coset, with actual conjugating frames
both signs of nonzero primitive quotient exponents
coarse rows and both incident slot types, separately
height-i coarse frame H^(i)=t^i H t^-i carries R_-i
the original Fox complex, via group-ring primitive basis changes and unit-pivot expansions

symbolic_interpretation.meaning: Identities in the free noncommutative integer algebra with the listed units. Coefficients c,e,s are not assumed central or invertible. z denotes u^m only in the power-identity applications.
symbolic_interpretation.power_nonvanishing: For every nonzero m, the signed interval support of S_m(u) is nonempty and consists of distinct powers of the infinite-order group element u; proof in report.md Section 2.

jacobian.scope: Auxiliary finite rational incidence sign check only; not support for the universal theorem.

certification_boundary: The Lean kernel certifies the universal algebraic core, not the group presentations, the affiliated-operator input, Mackey-Shapiro, or the full manuscript proposition. Those are proved or sourced in report.md and need independent mathematical review.
